The proof combines the library's lemmas `check_right`, `U_558` and `V_557` with `norm_num`. The only Mathlib facts it uses are the decimal bounds on π, `Real.pi_gt_d20` and `Real.pi_lt_d20`, and these are just ingredients, not the content of the statement.
